Docker stacks, SSL, Xdebug, and a desktop dashboard.","id":"gh:1152886960","install_available":false,"language":"Go","name":"govard","slug":"ddtcorex/govard","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dev-tools","django","docker","docker-compose","drupal","dsh-plugin","go","golang","laravel","local-development","magento","magento2","mageos","nextjs","shopware","symfony","wordpress","xdebug"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Go-based local development orchestrator for Magento, Laravel, Symfony, Next.js, WordPress, and more."},{"id":"p1s2","text":" Docker stacks, SSL, Xdebug, and a desktop dashboard."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# GOVARD: Go-based Versatile Runtime & Development"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Govard** is a professional-grade local development orchestrator engineered in Go. It replaces lega"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"cy bash-based tooling with a fast native binary that manages complex containerized environments with"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" a focus on stability, speed, and developer experience."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 🆚 Why Govard Stands Out"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| Area | Govard Advantage |
| :--- | :--- |
| Core architecture | Native Go binary with direct Docke"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"r SDK orchestration instead of shell-script glue. |
| Framework intelligence | Automatic framework d"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"iscovery + framework-specific blueprints + custom stack wizard. |
| Magento depth | First-class Mage"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"nto/OpenMage workflow (auto `env.php`/`local.xml` wiring, table prefixes, Varnish/Redis/queue/search"},{"id":"p5s5","text":", dedicated `php-debug` routing). |
| Local HTTPS/DNS | Built-in Caddy + `dnsmasq` + Root CA auto-tr"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ust for `*.test` domains. |
| Remote safety | `remote`/`sync` protections for sensitive targets (pro"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"d write blocking, scoped capabilities, audit logs). |
| Deployment | A framework recipe drives a neu"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"tral task pipeline (`deploy`), a container sandbox rehearses it locally, and an artifact mode keeps "},{"id":"p5s9","text":"CI jobs toolchain-free. |
| Team reproducibility | `govard lock` + `lock.strict` to detect environme"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"nt drift across machines. |
| Recovery workflow | `govard snapshot` for quick local DB/media checkpo"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"ints before risky operations. |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 🚀 Key Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **First-Class Deployment**: `govard deploy` publishes a revision over SSH + rsync with a framework"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" recipe, atomic symlink swap or in-place publish, maintenance windows, database backup, verification"},{"id":"p7s3","text":", rollback and resume — plus `govard sandbox` to rehearse the pipeline against a container on your m"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"achine.
- **Remote Management (Flagship)**: named remotes with scope-based capabilities (`files,medi"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"a,db,deploy`), flexible auth (`keychain`, `ssh-agent`, `keyfile`), safe sync with dry-run planning, "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"and connectivity diagnostics (`govard remote test`).
- **Shared SSH Gateway**: `govard-proxy-sshd` g"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ives every sandbox a stable address (`ssh -p 2222 <project>@127.0.0.1`, sftp included) instead of an"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" ephemeral port.
- **Infra Host Access**: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch at `http://<project>.test:9200` a"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"nd the RabbitMQ management UI at `http://<project>.test:15672` — per-project Caddy routes, no extra "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"config.
- **Framework Discovery**: Magento 1/OpenMage, Magento 2, Mage-OS, Laravel, Next.js, Emdash,"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" Drupal, Symfony, Shopware, CakePHP, PrestaShop, WordPress, and Django, plus an interactive custom-f"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ramework wizard.
- **Zero-Config Debugging**: Xdebug 2 & 3 with one-click toggling and project-speci"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"fic isolation.
- **Database Observability**: live query monitoring (`govard db top`), progress bars "},{"id":"p7s14","text":"for imports/syncs, Redis/Valkey management.
- **Static Analysis & Profiling**: `govard audit` (lint,"},{"id":"p7s15","text":" integrity, profiler) with persisted sessions, diffs, and reruns.
- **VSCode Integration**: `govard "},{"id":"p7s16","text":"vscode setup [--global]` runs Intelephense, PHPStan, PHPCS, PHPUnit, and Xdebug inside the container"},{"id":"p7s17","text":".
- **Global Services**: Caddy proxy, Mailpit, PHPMyAdmin, Portainer out of the box.
- **Team Safety"},{"id":"p7s18","text":" Nets**: snapshots, drift detection, 1Password (`op://`) secret references, resumable transfers.
- *"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"*CLI + Desktop**: the same engine in a terminal binary and a Wails desktop app; `govard self-update`"},{"id":"p7s20","text":" with checksum validation."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 🛠️ Installation"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Pick one channel and stick to it:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Channel | Command | Notes |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| npm | `npm i -g @ddtcorex/govard` | Node 20+, CLI only, any OS |
| Homebrew | `brew install ddtcor"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ex/tap/govard` | macOS + Linuxbrew, CLI only |
| Docker | `docker run ghcr.io/ddtcorex/govard:<versi"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"on> version` | No install needed; CI-friendly |
| CI | `uses: ddtcorex/setup-govard@v1` | GitHub Act"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ions, pinnable version |
| Script | `curl -fsSL .../install.sh \| bash` | Full installer (CLI + Desk"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"top where supported) |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The installer handles system dependencies, starts global services, and configures SSL trust. By defa"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ult it also installs `govard-desktop` on Linux where `WebKitGTK 6.0` and GTK 4 are available (Ubuntu"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" 24.04+, Debian 13+); pass `--cli-only` to skip Desktop explicitly, or let the installer fall back t"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"o CLI-only automatically where WebKitGTK 6.0 is missing (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, and every non-Linu"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"x platform). Tagged releases also ship `.deb`/`.pkg` installers, including a separate `govard-deskto"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"p_<version>_linux_<arch>.deb` — see the releases page and the installation guide for the full option"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"s. Do not mix channels on one machine (conflicting binaries across `/usr/bin` and `/usr/local/bin`)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Govard runs without Docker for host-side commands (`govard capabilities` lists every command's requi"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"rement); container-backed commands exit `3` with `CAPABILITY_MISSING` instead of failing midway.
